name: Subrat Kumar Senapati

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Subrat Kumar Senapati writes poetry and short fiction in Odia. His story collection Kadambabana, published by Pen In Books, received the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar for Odia in 2025. In its account of the award, Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan identified him as a horticulture faculty member and reported his interest in bringing the joys and sorrows of transgender lives into his writing.

His Kabita Live poems explore the uneasy border between dreams and waking life. “ନିଦ ବଟିକା” contrasts childhood’s protective embrace with an adult search for sleep, ending with a mother-like presence interrupting a retreat into darkness. In “ଖରାପ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ”, flowers, smoke and contrasting heights turn a strained relationship into a landscape of longing and distance.
